"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices"},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Always provide meaningful fallback content for critical UI slots to prevent broken layouts."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use named slots when building complex layout components like modals, cards, and application shells."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Remember that fallback content is completely ignored if the parent passes even an empty string or whitespace into the slot."}]
